chunks: Ali, from his father, from Hammad, from Hareyz, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said:
The Sunnah regarding the Ihram is the clipping of the nails, and taking off the moustache, and shaving the pubic area.

key_terms.الْإِحْرَامِ: The state of ritual consecration for Hajj or Umrah

ai.seo_question: What are the recommended grooming acts for Ihram according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi establishes the Sunnah of Tahaarah (ritual purity) by linking personal grooming—trimming nails, removing the moustache, and shaving pubic hair—to the sanctity of entering the state of Ihram. In Shia jurisprudence, this reflects the principle that physical cleanliness is an integral component of spiritual readiness for pilgrimage, mirroring the practices of the Prophet and the Imams. It underscores the holistic nature of Ihram, where external appearance aligns with internal devotion.
